Game Overview

Zombie Defence Team is a adventure title where face relentless hordes of undead in Zombie Defence Team. As a lone, well-armed soldier, strategically use your arsenal to fend off zombie attacks. Navigate dynamic landscapes, secure vantage points, and aim for headshots to conserve ammo. Can you outlast the swarm and clear each contaminated zone?
